name: AI Engine — AMD graphics (faster)
description: Same AI features, sped up by an AMD Radeon graphics card. Needs ROCm 7 with MIGraphX installed on this computer — Drift explains what to install if it is missing. Falls back to this computer if the card can't be used.
details: Complete ONNX Runtime build with the MIGraphX execution provider. ROCm is not bundled: install ROCm 7.x with MIGraphX (tested with 7.2) from AMD or your distribution, and make sure your user can open /dev/kfd (the render and video groups). Needs glibc 2.34 or newer. Flatpak: install AMD's ROCm under /opt, then run "flatpak override --user --filesystem=/opt:ro --device=all org.cutwire.Drift". Falls back to CPU when the device cannot be used. Upstream: Microsoft ONNX Runtime 1.27.1, the onnxruntime-migraphx wheel from PyPI. Platform: linux-x64.
author: Microsoft
